summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a business update and press release on July 13, 2026. The update covers operational milestones: an expanded Permit to Fly from the UK CAA, a new prototype, progress toward Critical Design Review by end of 2026, manufacturing facility timelines, and an extended certification target of 2029 for its Valo electric aircraft. No financial terms, M&A, activist, or restructuring elements are present. This is a routine progress report on aircraft development programs.
